title: Flood Year
tagline: You're the only teacher in a river village, and the water is rising.

facts.grain_store: The school's back room holds the grain.
facts.offer_open: An NGO offer letter sits unanswered.

cards.speaker: The school
cards.text: The river is a foot from the school steps. Cancel classes?

a.label: Keep teaching
a.later: The kids call it the floating school. Attendance went up.

b.label: Close the school
b.result: You lock the door against brown water and wait.
b.later: Three older kids went to work on the boats instead.

cards.speaker: The headman
cards.text: The headman wants the school as a grain store.

a.label: Give him the back room
a.result: Sacks stack where desks used to be.
a.later: The grain stayed dry. The village fed itself.

b.label: Refuse
b.result: He leaves angry. The classroom stays a classroom.
b.later: The grain rotted in a barn. Some people blame you.

cards.speaker: A city NGO
cards.text: A city NGO offers you a safe job downriver.

a.label: Stay
a.result: You thank them and put the letter away.
a.later: The village painted your name on the new boat.

b.label: Ask them to wait
b.result: You buy time. The letter stays on the desk.
b.later: The offer letter sits on your desk, unanswered.

a.label: Move everyone to the school roof
a.result: Ladders, blankets, names checked twice in the dark.
a.later: Ninety people slept on the roof. Nobody was lost.

b.label: Trust the levee
b.result: You listen to the river all night and do not sleep.
b.later: The levee held, just. You didn't sleep.

cards.speaker: The NGO
cards.text: The NGO calls a final time.

a.label: Take it
a.result: You say yes before the line can break.
a.later: You teach in the city now. The village sends you a photo every monsoon.

b.label: Decline for good
b.result: You end the call and open the stove door.
b.later: You burned the letter. It felt like the right fire.

endings.text: When the water goes down, they rebuild the school first.
The river takes the low fields and leaves the village. So does half of it.
